title: Information fusion and machine learning for sensitivity analysis using physics knowledge and experimental data
abstract: arXiv:2608.17248v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When computational models (either physics-based or data-driven) are used for the sensitivity analysis of engineering systems, the sensitivity estimate is affected by the accuracy and uncertainty of the model. This paper considers global sensitivity analysis (GSA) for situations where both a physics-based model and experimental observations are available, and investigates physics-informed machine learning strategies to effectively combine the two sources of information in order to maximize the accuracy of the sensitivity estimate. Two representative machine learning (ML) techniques are considered, namely, deep neural networks (DNN) and Gaussian process (GP) modeling, and two strategies for incorporating physics knowledge within these techniques are investigated, namely: (i) incorporating loss functions in the ML models to enforce physics constraints, and (ii) pre-training and updating the ML model using simulation and experimental data

translated_title: 基于物理知识与实验数据的信息融合与机器学习在灵敏度分析中的应用
translated_abstract: 摘要：当使用计算模型（无论是基于物理的还是数据驱动的）进行工程系统的灵敏度分析时，灵敏度估计会受到模型准确性和不确定性的影响。本文考虑了在同时拥有基于物理的模型和实验观测数据的情况下进行全局灵敏度分析（GSA），并研究了物理信息机器学习策略，以有效结合这两种信息源，从而最大化灵敏度估计的准确性。本文考虑了两种代表性的机器学习（ML）技术，即深度神经网络（DNN）和高斯过程（GP）建模，并研究了在这些技术中融入物理知识的两种策略，即：（i）在ML模型中引入损失函数以强制执行物理约束，以及（ii）使用模拟和实验数据对ML模型进行预训练和更新。
tldr: 本文提出利用物理信息机器学习策略（结合深度神经网络和高斯过程），通过融合物理模型与实验数据，有效提升全局灵敏度分析的准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes physics-informed machine learning strategies (combining deep neural networks and Gaussian processes) to effectively integrate physics-based models with experimental data, enhancing the accuracy of global sensitivity analysis.
